title: North Indian Fried Rice
description: A flavorful and spicy fried rice dish inspired by North Indian cuisine. Quick and easy to make with minimal ingredients.

ingredients.name: Fried Onions (available in store or make your own)
North Indian Spice Blend (available in store or make your own)

instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add zesty and North Indian Spice Blend and sauté for 1 minute.
Add fried onions and sauté for another minute.
Add golden rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add fried naan and break into pieces. Stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and adjust the zesty level to taste.
Optional: add a fried egg on top for extra protein.
